mesh_enabled.description: Enable or disable the Bluetooth Mesh subsystem.

mesh_state_dir.description: Directory where mesh application keys and node states are stored.

mesh_key_dir.description: Directory for storing sensitive application and network keys.

max_mesh_nodes.description: Maximum number of mesh nodes the daemon should support concurrently.

max_relay_buffer.description: Maximum number of relay messages to buffer.

relay_expiry_time.description: Number of seconds after which a relay message is discarded.

beacon_interval.description: Interval in seconds between beacon transmissions.

gatt_proxy_enabled.description: Enable or disable GATT proxy service (allows GATT-based provisioning and proxying).

friend_enabled.description: Enable or disable Friend node functionality (enables message caching for Low Power Nodes).

max_friend_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous Friend connections to support.

low_power_node_enabled.description: Enable or disable Low Power Node (LPN) support (requires Friend node).

max_low_power_nodes.description: Maximum number of Low Power Nodes to support.

poll_timeout.description: Number of seconds between poll messages sent by an LPN to its Friend.

friendship_retry_timeout.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying a failed Friendship establishment.

extra_config.description: List of custom key-value configuration overrides to append (e.g., [{"key": "DebugLevel", "value": "1"}]).
